steps: Create sandbox/demo-app/test_storage_keeps_file.py with a test that writes 'KEEP-ME' to a file, calls storage.save_records with a value json cannot serialize ({1, 2}), and asserts the file still holds 'KEEP-ME'; it fails on the current code because the file is truncated first.
In sandbox/demo-app/storage.py, serialize the records to JSON text before opening the target path.
Write the serialized text in a single write, so that a serialization failure leaves any existing file untouched.
